title: The workbench GitHub page
text: Current observations: One page in every mode: App installations with a Manage on GitHub link to repository-access settings, personal authorization when one is known, and project mappings. Hosted marks installation facts live. Local and self-hosted show when each installation was last checked; Check now runs projects.github_binding.check for every bound project in scope and names any refusal's reason and recovery. Facts the page cannot read are hidden, never shown as unavailable. Installation bound counts cover all visible projects, independent of the selected mapping scope. Unbind confirms removal of the mapping, capability and secrets; its result teaches that issue sync is off and how to bind and enable it again. Hosted service inventory uses projects.github_binding.list with org authority and an optional installation filter. The unbind domain result owns the sync-mode notice displayed by the page. Desired hosted teaching: each GitHub account installation serves exactly one hosted Yoke org. Connect explicitly reviews the GitHub account and all or selected repository access even when only one installation is available. A second org's Connect refuses github_installation_owned, names the owning org, and teaches the recovery: unbind every project and then Detach from the old org before connecting to the new org in the same environment; do not uninstall the App from GitHub for this move. Installing from GitHub directs the person to finish from the organization's GitHub page. This exclusive ownership applies to hosted orgs; local and self-hosted retain their access checks.
verification: Companion Platform item PLAT-293 records landed implementation; hosted deployment proof pending.
